name: TrailComfort Walking Shoes
description: Everyday walking shoes with a cushioned EVA foam midsole, breathable mesh upper and removable comfort insole. Designed for short walks and daily errands; not rated as waterproof.

name: RidgeRunner Hiking Boots
description: Mid-height hiking boots with a waterproof membrane, reinforced toe protection and a textured rubber outsole. Designed for day hikes on uneven paths.

name: RainGuard Waterproof Trousers
description: Waterproof hiking trousers with taped seams, adjustable cuffs, full-length side zips for pulling on over boots and two zipped pockets.

name: SummitShell Rain Jacket
description: Lightweight waterproof shell jacket with taped seams, an adjustable hood, pit zips and a packable design. Suitable for wet-weather hikes.

name: BreezeDry Running Tee
description: Quick-drying short-sleeved running top made from lightweight moisture-wicking fabric. Reflective detailing improves visibility in low light.

name: AlpineWarm Fleece Pullover
description: Midweight fleece pullover with a half zip, soft brushed interior and two handwarmer pockets. Intended as an insulating layer in cool conditions.

name: SunPath Wide-Brim Hat
description: Wide-brim sun hat made from tightly woven fabric, with a ventilated crown and an adjustable chin cord. The brim provides shade for the face and neck.

name: CampRest Sleeping Bag
description: Three-season synthetic-fill sleeping bag with a hood, draft collar and two-way zip. Manufacturer comfort rating: 5 degrees Celsius.

name: RiverStone Water Bottle
description: One-litre stainless-steel reusable water bottle with a leak-resistant screw cap and a carry loop. Not insulated.

name: GripTrek Walking Poles
description: Adjustable aluminium walking poles with cork-look grips, wrist straps, replaceable rubber tips and baskets for soft ground.

name: StormPeak Ski Trousers
description: Insulated ski trousers with a waterproof outer fabric, internal snow gaiters and articulated knees. Designed for resort skiing.

name: UrbanStep Comfort Trainers
description: Casual trainers with a padded collar, foam footbed and flexible rubber outsole. Suitable for everyday city wear; no waterproof claim.

name: ColdTrail Thermal Socks
description: Merino-blend hiking socks with cushioned heels and toes, ribbed arch support and flat toe seams for comfort inside boots.

name: ForestLite Daypack
description: Twenty-litre daypack with adjustable shoulder straps, hydration sleeve, exterior bottle pockets and a rain cover stored in the base.

name: EcoFlex Stretch Hiking Shorts
description: Lightweight stretch hiking shorts with a quick-drying finish, adjustable waistband and three zipped pockets. Not waterproof.

name: GlacierShield Winter Gloves
description: Insulated winter gloves with a waterproof insert, adjustable wrist closures and textured palms for grip in wet conditions.

name: PathFinder Trail Runners
description: Trail running shoes with a rock plate, breathable mesh, grippy lugged outsole and responsive foam cushioning. No EVA specification is provided.

name: FreshStep Odour-Control Insoles
description: Replacement shoe insoles with antimicrobial odour-control treatment, light arch contour and cushioning foam. Trim-to-fit sizing.

name: SnowLine Gaiters
description: Protective gaiters with a water-resistant nylon outer, underfoot straps and hook-and-loop front closures to keep debris and snow out of hiking boots.

name: CoastalWind Windbreaker
description: Packable lightweight windbreaker with an adjustable hem and a breathable mesh lining. Wind resistant, but not waterproof.
